videos.title: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 Billion
videos.description: AMD is acquiring World Labs, an AI startup founded by industry pioneer and researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock transaction valuing World Labs at about $8.2 billion. AMD CEO Lisa Su and World Labs co-founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li sit down with Bloomberg Tech's Ed Ludlow to discuss why AMD is purchasing World Labs, the two companies' shared vision for AI's future encompassing all layers of the stack, and how the industry needs to come together for shared responsibility in developing a safe technology that benefits all of society. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: MAIA: Meta Taps MongoDB CEO to Lead New Enterprise AI Platform, ft. Seth Fiegerman | Open Interest
videos.description: Seth Fiegerman says Meta is moving aggressively into AI agents, with a new enterprise product that looks like a ‘Muse’-style assistant for workplace use. He notes that the company’s push suggests the focus is shifting from building the underlying AI technology to packaging it into tools that connect with day-to-day work and personal applications. Fiegerman also says the move may help Meta justify its huge spending on chips and data centers by creating a paid enterprise offering with a clearer path to revenue. On-screen text highlights that Zuckerberg introduced the Meta enterprise platform and that Meta tapped MongoDB’s CEO to lead it.
